liturgicalDay.name: Memorial of Saint Elizabeth of Hungary, Religious

introTexts.morning-prayer: For Jennifer, that God help her study well, retain what she learns, and pass the California bar exam, and use her work as a lawyer for truth and justice. Saint Thomas More, pray for them.
introTexts.daily-rosary: For my godchildren Liz, Danny, Abigail, and Levi, that God protect them in body and soul, keep them close to Him, and lead them to eternal life. Saint Michael the Archangel, pray for them.
introTexts.marian-antiphon-angelus: For Dylan, in thanksgiving that he made the basketball team this year, that God use the season to grow him in discipline, humility, and joy in Him. Saint Sebastian, pray for us.
introTexts.auxilium-christianorum: For my godchildren Liz, Danny, Abigail, and Levi, that God protect them in body and soul, keep them close to Him, and lead them to eternal life. Saint Michael the Archangel, pray for them.
introTexts.daily-reflection: For Sam Shorter, forgive his sins, purify him, and grant him eternal rest in Your presence. Saint Nicholas of Tolentino, pray for them.
introTexts.ext-invitatory: For Sam Shorter, forgive his sins, purify him, and grant him eternal rest in Your presence. Saint Nicholas of Tolentino, pray for them.
introTexts.ext-morning-prayer: For the institution of marriage, that marriages all over the world, in our extended family, and in my own marriage grow in faithful love and lead spouses and children to heaven. Saints Louis and Zélie Martin, pray for us.
introTexts.ext-midmorning-prayer: For Dylan, in thanksgiving that he made the basketball team this year, that God use the season to grow him in discipline, humility, and joy in Him. Saint Sebastian, pray for us.
introTexts.ext-midday-prayer: For Dylan, that God heal his sickness, restore his strength, and use it to form him to love and serve Him all his life. Saint Raphael the Archangel, pray for us.
introTexts.ext-midafternoon-prayer: For my godchildren Liz, Danny, Abigail, and Levi, that God protect them in body and soul, keep them close to Him, and lead them to eternal life. Saint Michael the Archangel, pray for them.
introTexts.ext-office-of-readings: For my godchildren Liz, Danny, Abigail, and Levi, that God protect them in body and soul, keep them close to Him, and lead them to eternal life. Saint Michael the Archangel, pray for them.
introTexts.ext-evening-prayer: For perseverance, that I stay dedicated to God in every task, do all my work for His glory, and hold fast to Him until eternal life. Saint Benedict, pray for us.
introTexts.ext-night-prayer: For Sam Shorter, forgive his sins, purify him, and grant him eternal rest in Your presence. Saint Nicholas of Tolentino, pray for them.
introTexts.ext-bible-in-a-year: For my godchildren Liz, Danny, Abigail, and Levi, that God protect them in body and soul, keep them close to Him, and lead them to eternal life. Saint Michael the Archangel, pray for them.
introTexts.ext-gospel-exegesis: For all my family members, that they return to full participation in the Holy Catholic Church and live in God's grace on the road to eternal life. Our Lady, Mother of the Church, pray for them.
introTexts.ext-saint-of-the-day: For Tonio and his wife Andrea, that God bless them with a healthy child and make their home a place of faith, where their child grows toward eternal life. Saint Gerard Majella, pray for them.
introTexts.ext-usccb-readings: For Andy's daughter Mila, that her crisis of faith lead her to the fullness of truth in Jesus Christ and His Holy, Catholic, and Apostolic Church, and to eternal life with Him. Saint Monica, pray for them.
